title: Read of a string from Bytes.unsafe_to_string is moved after a later write to the bytes
summary: `let c = String.get (Bytes.unsafe_to_string b) 0 in Bytes.set b 0 'z'; c` returns `'z'`: the read of the string is done after the write, in a use that the documentation of `Bytes.unsafe_to_string` allows. With `-flambda2-expert-cmm-safe-subst` the read stays in place when the write is a call, not when it is an inline store as here.
cause: `Bytes.unsafe_to_string` is erased in `middle_end/flambda2/from_lambda/lambda_to_lambda_transforms.ml` and a string load has no coeffect (`middle_end/flambda2/terms/flambda_primitive.ml`), so the translation to Cmm substitutes the load, used once, past the write.

fix.text: Gives the load of a string the coeffect of the load of bytes. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.

reference: related: issue #4803 (a call moved after a load; not the same)
